summary_en: GNI Group to acquire Ayumi Pharmaceutical Holdings and make it a wholly-owned subsidiary. Tender offer terms, premium, minimum acceptance threshold, and board recommendation not disclosed in excerpt provided.
title_en: Full Subsidiary Acquisition of Ayumi Pharmaceutical Holdings Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: GNI Group Ltd. announced its intention to acquire Ayumi Pharmaceutical Holdings Co., Ltd. and make it a wholly-owned subsidiary through a tender offer. The disclosure document agenda indicates sections covering transaction highlights, strategic rationale, and company overviews of both GNI Group and Ayumi Pharmaceutical Holdings. The first two pages provided contain only cover matter and agenda; the tender offer price, share count, acceptance conditions, and timeline are not included in the excerpt.
